rows.en: ＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿００２Oh, good. It was so long ago,￥I thought you'd forgotten.
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿００５I see...￥That's all right, then...＝＠１６４＿００６Um, sorry for bothering you.
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿００８Thank you so much for answering￥all my questions back then.＝＠１６４＿００９After that, I kept looking into￥Project Elan.
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０１０It's an amazing plan, isn't it?￥I learned a lot looking into it.
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０１１I also looked into the people￥they call candidates...＝＠１６４＿０１２You're really outstanding,￥aren't you?
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０１３You're not?＝＠１６４＿０１４But your results are always at￥the very top...
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０１５I guess it's no big deal to you.
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０１６I was searching through all￥kinds of data, and I found it...
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０１９Um... Then I'll go apologize.＝＠１６４＿０２０Who should I tell about￥something like this? One of the￥facility staff, maybe...＝＠１６４＿０２１I'll go right now.
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０２２I also walked around the￥facility a little.＝＠１６４＿０２３There are all kinds of rooms￥here, aren't there?＝＠１６４＿０２４Like the place with all the￥plants growing...
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０２５Have you been there?＝＠１６４＿０２６If you like, why don't we go￥there together now?
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０２７Then let's go.￥I'll show you the way.
＊Sarai＊＠１６４＿０２８I see. All right.￥Then I'll go by myself.
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿００１There are so many plants￥growing here.＝＠１６５＿００２To look after this many kinds of￥plants, the equipment must be￥really advanced.
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿００３Huh...?＝＠１６５＿００４This flower doesn't look￥very healthy...＝＠１６５＿００５Hm? This soil...
－　Sarai crouches with a handful￥　　of soil, lost in thought　－
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿００６There's too much phosphate in￥this. Potassium, too.＝＠１６５＿００７I think they gave it a little￥too much fertilizer.＝＠１６５＿００８If you add some fresh soil,￥it'll perk right up.
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿００９And I think it could use a￥little more manganese...
You know a lot about it.
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０１０Yes...?￥I can sort of tell by touch...
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０１１Can't most people tell?￥I'm not really sure about￥things like that...
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０１２Do I...?＝＠１６５＿０１３When I touch soil, I can sort of￥tell what nutrients are in it.￥So...
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０１４Can't most people tell?￥I'm not really sure about￥things like that...
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０１６Oh... I...＝＠１６５＿０１７You're right. Something like￥this is creepy, isn't it.＝＠１６５＿０１８I'm sorry.￥I won't come see you anymore.＝＠１６５＿０１９Goodbye.
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０２１I'm starting to understand most￥things about this facility, and￥about Elan...＝＠１６５＿０２２But I don't understand anything￥about myself.
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０２３I'm going to look into￥lots more things.＝＠１６５＿０２４Maybe that will help bring my￥memory back.
＊Sarai＊＠１６５＿０２５Well, I'll be going now.￥We'll meet again, won't we?
－　Sarai has gone...　－＝－　?!　￥　　Narusawa is watching Sarai￥　　　walk away, looking wary　－
＊Narusawa＊＠１６５＿０２６That was...￥...＝＠１６６＿００１If I remember right...＝＠１６５＿０２７I hope I'm just seeing things...￥but was he an SPN type...?
